artworks.title: Une moria a Bordiquier (Italie)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with structures and vegetation. The view is from a slightly elevated perspective, revealing the landscape and structures. The horizon line is high in the composition, with sparse clouds above. In the distance, there is a body of water. Nearby, there is an ancient stone structure, possibly a mill or well, with an arch and large wheel. Vegetation surrounds the structure. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing textures like stone and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with earthy tones dominating the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river winding through it. A line of trees marks the horizon. The brushstrokes show detailed textures of trees, foliage, and water. The color palette is predominantly sepia. The river reflects branches and vegetation. A bridge crosses the river in the distance. The sky has swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Signore Sebastiano Conca, Pittore Napoletano (Signore Sebastiano Conca, Neapolitan Painter)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper mounted on album page
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a studio setting. The individual is in profile with a slight turn towards the viewer, engaged in painting at an easel. They have distinct facial features, aged yet expressive, and medium-length curly hair. They are dressed in formal attire typical of an artist of their era. The person holds a palette with brushes in one hand and is painting on a canvas. Nearby, an additional palette and set of brushes rest on a chair with an ornate cushion. The background features a canvas on an easel to the left with outlined artwork. The setting suggests an artistic environment with line work indicating an interior space.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins
artworks.description: The artwork shows a depiction of classical ruins surrounded by a dense, wild landscape. The ruins are viewed from a lower angle, with additional ruins visible in the background. The scene is meticulously detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching techniques to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, highlighting the intricate details of the ruins, vegetation, and figures. Figures are present among the ruins in various activities. The overall atmosphere conveys a sense of abandoned grandeur, as nature overtakes the remnants of a past civilization.

artworks.title: Landscape with Classical Ruins
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 29.4 x 43 cm (11 9/16 x 16 15/16 in.)
overall (separate inscription plate): 2.5 x 42.1 cm (1 x 16 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays ancient ruins with a partially collapsed grand arch framing the scene. In the center, people in classical attire are engaged in various activities. A statue stands on a pedestal in the background. The artwork features intricate etching with fine lines and cross-hatching creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using contrast between dark lines and light paper. The scene conveys a sense of antiquity and classical reflection, with decrepit stone structures and lush vegetation.

artworks.title: Figure Leading a Horse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite with gray gouache on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 13.7 x 18.3 cm (5 3/8 x 7 3/16 in.)
support: 30.6 x 23.4 cm (12 1/16 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person and a horse. The person is partially seen, looking towards the horse. The person's facial features are roughly drawn in profile, with an open mouth. The person appears to have short hair or a head covering. They are wearing a garment with flowing lines, holding an indistinct object or part of the horse's harness. In the background, there are no distinct details, focusing on the interaction between the person and the horse in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Dream of Saint Joseph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Nativity scene with figures, animals, and architecture. The artwork shows various elements typically associated with nativity. On the left are animals near a rustic stable structure. In the center is a figure, possibly an angel, gesturing towards a seated figure enveloped in drapery. On the right are two figures, one seemingly attending to an infant. The background features detailed architecture with arches and rectangles. The drawing is characterized by intricate line work and hatching, creating depth and texture. The composition conveys a sense of serene reverence through the detailed depiction of the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Saint Joseph Listening to the Angel's Counsel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel guiding a family and a donkey. The drawing depicts an angel hovering over and guiding an adult standing beside a donkey, while another adult is seated, cradling a child. The background shows architectural ruins with columns and a distant landscape of hills and trees under an expansive sky. The composition is detailed with finely etched lines capturing the motion of the figures and the textures of their flowing garments. The scene conveys themes of guidance and protection amidst a classical landscape.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: one person leading a donkey carrying another individual wrapped in cloth. They are surrounded by bushes and shrubbery with intricate line work. In the background, there is a structure with two columns and an orb on the left. Trees line the horizon under a cloudy sky. Further back, a complex of buildings with rectangular shapes and rooftops is visible among more trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between dark lines and light paper.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Preparing to Embark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a countryside scene with elements of classical architecture. The image shows a rural scene where a person herds a donkey across a wooden bridge. A woman, wearing a long flowing garment, stands on the bridge. In the background, there are classical structures, such as a temple and ruins, surrounded by vegetation and mountains. The drawing style reflects a traditional approach that captures the beauty and simplicity of the scene.

artworks.title: The Return from Egypt
artworks.description: This image features a scene with architectural and natural elements. The viewpoint is from slightly above, looking down onto a composition with town structures, trees, and a distant cityscape. The artwork is created with intricate, fine brushstrokes in a linear, etching style. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or brown ink lines against a cream background. The scene includes figures in draped attire, stone structures, foliage, and classical buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with three figures and a donkey. The drawing depicts three robed figures walking beside a donkey. The central figure is guiding the other two, one of which appears to be a smaller, younger figure. The scene is set against a backdrop of trees and architectural structures, suggesting a rural environment. In the distance, there are hills and possibly a cityscape. The atmosphere is serene, with detailed attention to the natural elements such as the leaves on trees and textures of fabric in the clothing. The lines are clear and defined, providing a sense of movement to the subjects within the scene.

artworks.title: The Vision (L'apparition)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, showcasing a dense cluster of trees stretching across the scene. The horizon is low and obscured by natural elements, with faint outlines of distant structures or foliage. Brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the texture of leaves and branches with fine strokes. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or brown. Closest are lush textures of plants and shrubs, while in the distance, foliage recedes, creating layers behind the tree branches. The tallest trees rise toward the top right, becoming the most prominent element.

artworks.title: Atlanta and Meleager Hunting the Boar of Calydon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene involving a boar. The image depicts a scene set in a forest with tall trees. At the center is a large boar being attacked by a group of hunters armed with bows and spears. Horses are also shown in dynamic poses. To the side, there is a small water feature where a figure reclines, pouring water from a jug. The scene is filled with action and movement, capturing the intensity of the hunt. The texture and line work suggest an emphasis on the dramatic energy of the scene, characteristic of classical-style hunting imagery.

artworks.title: A Stag Hunt
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved artwork depicting a dynamic scene viewed from the side with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon features a line of distant hills, trees, and swirling clouds. In the foreground, riders on horseback and hunting dogs pursue a lion. The figures are detailed with fine strokes, showcasing classical engraving style. The color palette is monochromatic with black, white, and shades of gray. Tall trees frame the composition, adding to the sense of movement and vigor.

artworks.title: The Flaying of Marsyas
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a forested landscape. The scene includes trees, hills, mountains, a structure, and three figures in a dynamic interaction. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with dark and light shades.

artworks.title: The Moles (Les Taupes)
artworks.medium: etching with stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white etching featuring a landscape with a prominent bare, twisted tree with small animals hanging from its branches. The horizon is low in the composition with a vast sky and other trees and shrubbery in the distance. Fine lines create texture and depth, especially in the tree branches, animal fur, foliage, and clouds. The color palette is monochrome, enhancing the somber tone. Close to us, plants and text can be seen in the bottom left corner. The landscape slopes upward, with more foliage and distant tree canopies against the sky in the background.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La modiste)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two sculpted figures and various objects. The composition includes two busts, a figure in profile with an elaborate hairstyle, and partially sketched garment or cloth. The drawing exhibits a sketchy style with sparse lines emphasizing the forms and features. The lines are light and loose, giving an impression of quick motion or an initial draft. Shading through line movements adds texture and dimension. The scene suggests an art or craftsmanship setting.

artworks.title: Aux environs de Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a view captured from a slightly elevated angle, featuring a path winding through lush vegetation, flanked by large trees on the left and right. The sky acts as a backdrop. The intricate details of the trees, foliage, and water are depicted in delicate etching strokes. A group of people can be seen walking along the path, adding scale and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Pond in the Tuileries (Le bassin des Tuileries)
artworks.description: The image displays a park scene captured from eye level. There is a cluster of leafless trees to the left framing a bustling area where people stroll and engage in activities. The brushstrokes are smooth with an emphasis on line and form. The color palette comprises muted earthy tones. Past the individuals, the scene extends to a body of water with small boats and figures in the distance. An architectural structure can be seen beyond the trees on the right.

artworks.title: Aux Environs de Menton
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with an elevated viewpoint. The sea meets the sky on the horizon, with boats present. The artwork features detailed and linear brushstrokes outlining the landscape, trees, and vegetation. A tree shades a pathway where a figure on horseback and another person are seen near the water. Buildings are visible in the distance. The color scheme is monochrome, focusing on light and dark contrast.

artworks.title: Barque de pecheurs faisant escale dans les rochers de Collioure
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a rocky shoreline, a body of water, a low horizon, a sky, and a detailed landscape with a fishing boat anchored close by. There are figures near the boat and rocky outcrops creating a boundary. The right side of the image shows rocky formations climbing upwards. The color palette is warm and earthy, with tan and deep shadows highlighting the composition's contrast.

artworks.title: Cabanes de pecheurs sur les cotes d'Italie
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal area with fishing huts along the water's edge. In the background are hills. On the left are fishing huts, some boats on the shoreline, and two boats in the water. The sky has detailed clouds in cross-hatched brushstrokes. The scene is depicted in a monochrome palette of creams and blacks.

artworks.title: Canal aux Martiques
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene with two boats, one with a sail unfolded on the water and another boat by the shoreline. A small bird is in the water, and structures resembling buildings are visible along the canal's edge. The sky is mottled, and the color palette is primarily dark browns and blacks against a lighter background. The use of fine etching lines creates intricate textures capturing the sky, water, and landforms.
